method: Digest-bound original ELF disassembly and static dataflow inspection; no native execution or emulation.

facts.label: first state byte as copy source

limitations: Full Noop prefix, prior nonce/vault/expiry suffix and bounded single-block inner digest for valid typed inputs. Raw action tag0x86 is not a wire discriminant claim.
Normal successful allocation and byte-copy helper behavior are premises. All four preimage lengths20/29/40/49 are strictly below136. General streaming and multi-block paths are excluded.
The existing MIT permutation implementation and RE-009-sponge-permutation-115 evidence are credited prerequisites; no captured instruction evaluator is run.
No private keys, signing, domain signature, authorization, wire decoding, live request, node execution/emulation or acceptance of the action is established.
